        return self.last_shot + WEAPON_STATS[self.weapon]["fire_rate"] <= time.time()

    def reload(self):
        self.ammo = min(WEAPON_STATS[self.weapon]["ammo"], self.ammo + 5)
        self.cooldowns["reload"] = WEAPON_STATS[self.weapon]["reload_time"]

    def apply_powerup(self, powerup_type: PowerUpType):
        effect = POWERUP_EFFECTS[powerup_type]
        if "health" in effect:
            self.heal(effect["health"])
        if "ammo" in effect:
            self.ammo += effect["ammo"]
        if "speed_multiplier" in effect:
            self.speed_multiplier = effect["speed_multiplier"]
            self.cooldowns["speed_boost"] = effect["duration"]
        if "shield" in effect:
            self.add_shield(effect["shield"])
            self.cooldowns["shield"] = effect["duration"]
        if "invisibility" in effect:
            self.invisibility = True
            self.cooldowns["invisibility"] = effect["duration"]
        if "damage_multiplier" in effect:
            self.damage_multiplier = effect["damage_multiplier"]
            self.cooldowns["damage_boost"] = effect["duration"]
        if "teleport" in effect:
            # Teleport to a random safe location (implementation would need map data)
            pass

    def get_status(self) -> Dict:
        return {
            "id": self.id,
            "team": self.team,
            "health": self.health,
            "shield": self.shield,
            "ammo": self.ammo,
            "weapon": self.weapon.value,
            "speed": self.speed * self.speed_multiplier,
            "is_alive": self.is_alive,
            "ai_state": self.ai_state.value,
            "role": self.role,
            "experience": self.experience,
            "kill_streak": self.kill_streak,
            "objectives_completed": self.objectives_completed,
            "position": (self.position.x, self.position.y, self.position.z),
            "invisibility": self.invisibility,
            "damage_multiplier": self.damage_multiplier,
            "speed_multiplier": self.speed_multiplier,
            "cooldowns": self.cooldowns.copy()
        }

@dataclass
class PowerUp:
    type: PowerUpType
    position: Position
    spawn_time: float
    duration: float = 30.0  # How long it stays on the map
    collected: bool = False

    def is_expired(self, current_time: float) -> bool:
        return current_time - self.spawn_time > self.duration

@dataclass
class Objective:
    type: ObjectiveType
    position: Position
    team: str = ""
    captured_by: Optional[str] = None
    progress: float = 0.0  # For capture objectives
    required_team_count: int = 1  # Number of robots needed to capture
    is_active: bool = True
    description: str = ""

    def update_progress(self, team: str, robot_count: int):
        if team == self.team and self.type == ObjectiveType.CAPTURE_THE_FLAG:
            self.progress = min(1.0, self.progress + (robot_count / self.required_team_count) * 0.1)
            if self.progress >= 1.0:
                self.captured_by = team
                self.is_active = False
                return True
        elif self.type == ObjectiveType.DOMINATION:
            if team == self.team:
                # Domination: capture point by having robots nearby
                self.progress = min(1.0, self.progress + (robot_count / self.required_team_count) * 0.05)
                if self.progress >= 1.0:
                    self.captured_by = team
            else:
                # Opposing team reduces progress
                self.progress = max(0.0, self.progress - 0.02)
        return False

@dataclass
class EnvironmentalHazard:
    position: Position
    radius: float
    damage_per_second: float
    active: bool = True
    duration: float = 60.0
    spawn_time: float = 0.0

    def is_expired(self, current_time: float) -> bool:
        return current_time - self.spawn_time > self.duration

@dataclass
class Team:
    name: str
    color: str
    robots: List[Robot] = field(default_factory=list)
    score: int = 0
    objectives_completed: int = 0
    base_position: Position = field(default_factory=lambda: Position(0, 0, 0))
    flag_position: Optional[Position] = None
    payload_position: Optional[Position] = None
    is_defending: bool = False

    def add_robot(self, robot: Robot):
        self.robots.append(robot)

    def get_alive_robots(self) -> List[Robot]:
        return [r for r in self.robots if r.is_alive]

    def get_total_experience(self) -> int:
        return sum(r.experience for r in self.robots)

    def get_average_experience(self) -> float:
        alive_robots = self.get_alive_robots()
        if not alive_robots:
            return 0
        return sum(r.experience for r in alive_robots) / len(alive_robots)

@dataclass
class GameState:
    current_time: float = 0.0
    is_running: bool = False
    teams: List[Team] = field(default_factory=list)
    robots: List[Robot] = field(default_factory=list)
    powerups: List[PowerUp] = field(default_factory=list)
    hazards: List[EnvironmentalHazard] = field(default_factory=list)
    objectives: List[Objective] = field(default_factory=list)
    last_powerup_spawn: float = 0.0
    last_hazard_spawn: float = 0.0
    match_result: Optional[str] = None
    winner: Optional[str] = None
    map_size: Tuple[float, float, float] = field(default_factory=lambda: (200, 200, 100))  # x, y, z
    difficulty: str = "medium"  # "easy", "medium", "hard"
    learning_data: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)  # For AI learning

    def get_team_by_name(self, team_name: str) -> Optional[Team]:
        for team in self.teams:
            if team.name == team_name:
                return team
        return None

    def get_robot_by_id(self, robot_id: int) -> Optional[Robot]:
        for robot in self.robots:
            if robot.id == robot_id:
                return robot
        return None

    def get_alive_robots(self) -> List[Robot]:
        return [r for r in self.robots if r.is_alive]

    def get_team_robots(self, team_name: str) -> List[Robot]:
        team = self.get_team_by_name(team_name)
        return team.robots if team else []

    def get_closest_powerup(self, robot: Robot) -> Optional[PowerUp]:
        closest = None
        min_dist = float('inf')
        for pu in self.powerups:
            if pu.collected:
                continue
            dist = robot.position.distance_to(pu.position)
            if dist < min_dist and dist < robot.vision_range:
                min_dist = dist
                closest = pu
        return closest

    def get_closest_enemy(self, robot: Robot) -> Optional[Robot]:
        closest = None
        min_dist = float('inf')
        for other in self.robots:
            if other.is_alive and other.team != robot.team:
                dist = robot.position.distance_to(other.position)
                if dist < min_dist and dist < robot.vision_range:
                    min_dist = dist
                    closest = other
        return closest

    def get_closest_objective(self, robot: Robot) -> Optional[Objective]:
        closest = None
        min_dist = float('inf')
        for obj in self.objectives:
            if not obj.is_active:
                continue
            # Only consider objectives that the robot can interact with
            if obj.type == ObjectiveType.CAPTURE_THE_FLAG and obj.captured_by != robot.team:
                dist = robot.position.distance_to(obj.position)
                if dist < min_dist and dist < robot.vision_range:
                    min_dist = dist
                    closest = obj
        return closest

    def get_nearest_hazard(self, robot: Robot) -> Optional[EnvironmentalHazard]:
        closest = None
        min_dist = float('inf')
        for hazard in self.hazards:
            if hazard.active:
                dist = robot.position.distance_to(hazard.position)
                if dist < min_dist:
                    min_dist = dist
                    closest = hazard
        return closest

    def apply_team_score(self, team_name: str, points: int):
        team = self.get_team_by_name(team_name)
        if team:
            team.score += points

    def calculate_team_rankings(self) -> List[Tuple[str, int]]:
        return sorted([(team.name, team.score) for team in self.teams], key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)

    def evaluate_difficulty(self):
        # Calculate average team experience and adjust difficulty
        avg_exp = sum(t.get_average_experience() for t in self.teams) / max(1, len(self.teams))
        if avg_exp > 150:
            self.difficulty = "hard"
        elif avg_exp > 80:
            self.difficulty = "medium"
        else:
            self.difficulty = "easy"

        # Adjust AI behavior based on difficulty
        for robot in self.robots:
            if robot.team == "AI_Opponent":
                if self.difficulty == "easy":
                    robot.vision_range = 40
                    robot.speed = 4.0
                    robot.ai_state = random.choice([AIState.IDLE, AIState.PATROL])
                elif self.difficulty == "medium":
                    robot.vision_range = 70
                    robot.speed = 5.0
                    robot.ai_state = random.choice([AIState.ATTACK, AIState.DEFEND])
                else:  # hard
                    robot.vision_range = 100
                    robot.speed = 6.0
                    robot.ai_state = AIState.ATTACK
                    # Hard mode: AI uses more complex strategies

class AIBrain:
    def __init__(self, robot: Robot, game_state: GameState):
        self.robot = robot
        self.game_state = game_state
        self.last_decision_time = 0
        self.decision_cooldown = 1.0  # Decision every second
        self.memory = deque(maxlen=20)  # Memory of recent actions and outcomes
        self.strategy_history = defaultdict(int)  # Track success of strategies
        self.current_strategy = None

    def update(self, delta_time: float):
        if self.robot.is_alive and time.time() - self.last_decision_time > self.decision_cooldown:
            self.decide_action()
            self.last_decision_time = time.time()

    def decide_action(self):
        # Update robot's role based on team needs and performance
        self.update_role()

        # Check for immediate threats
        closest_enemy = self.game_state.get_closest_enemy(self.robot)
        closest_powerup = self.game_state.get_closest_powerup(self.robot)
        closest_objective = self.game_state.get_closest_objective(self.robot)
        nearest_hazard = self.game_state.get_nearest_hazard(self.robot)

        # Check for active cooldowns
        if "invisibility" in self.robot.cooldowns and self.robot.cooldowns["invisibility"] > 0:
            self.robot.ai_state = AIState.ATTACK
            return

        # Check for low health - retreat if needed
        if self.robot.health < 30 and self.robot.shield == 0:
            # Retreat to base or safe area
            self.robot.ai_state = AIState.RETREAT
            self.robot.target = None
            return

        # Check for power-up if close and not in combat
        if closest_powerup and not closest_enemy:
            dist_to_powerup = self.robot.position.distance_to(closest_powerup.position)
            if dist_to_powerup < 30 and self.robot.ammo < 5:
                self.robot.ai_state = AIState.SEEK_POWERUP
                self.robot.target = None
                return

        # Check for objectives
        if closest_objective:
            # If objective is critical and we're not already assigned
            if self.robot.role in ["scout", "attacker"] and self.robot.objectives.count(closest_objective.description) == 0:
                self.robot.objectives.append(closest_objective.description)
                self.robot.ai_state = AIState.CAPTURE
                self.robot.target = None
                return

        # Attack if enemy is visible and we're not retreating
        if closest_enemy and closest_enemy.is_alive:
            dist_to_enemy = self.robot.position.distance_to(closest_enemy.position)
            # If we can engage and it's not too far
            if dist_to_enemy < self.robot.vision_range and dist_to_enemy > 5:
                # If we have ammo and weapon is ranged
                if self.robot.ammo > 0 and WEAPON_STATS[self.robot.weapon]["range"] >= dist_to_enemy:
                    self.robot.ai_state = AIState.ATTACK
                    self.robot.target = closest_enemy.id
                    return
                # If melee weapon and close enough
                elif dist_to_enemy < 10 and WEAPON_STATS[self.robot.weapon]["range"] >= dist_to_enemy:
                    self.robot.ai_state = AIState.ATTACK
                    self.robot.target = closest_enemy.id
                    return

        # Defend base if we're a defender and enemy is near base
        if self.robot.role == "defender":
            team = self.game_state.get_team_by_name(self.robot.team)
            if team and team.base_position:
                dist_to_base = self.robot.position.distance_to(team.base_position)
                # If enemy is near base, defend
                for enemy in self.game_state.get_alive_robots():
                    if enemy.team != self.robot.team:
                        dist_to_enemy = self.robot.position.distance_to(enemy.position)
                        dist_enemy_to_base = enemy.position.distance_to(team.base_position)
                        if dist_enemy_to_base < 40 and dist_to_enemy < 60:
                            self.robot.ai_state = AIState.DEFEND
                            self.robot.target = None
                            return

        # Patrol if no urgent actions
        self.robot.ai_state = AIState.PATROL
        self.robot.target = None

    def update_role(self):
        """Dynamically assign roles based on team composition and game state"""
        team = self.game_state.get_team_by_name(self.robot.team)
        if not team:
            return

        alive_robots = team.get_alive_robots()
        if len(alive_robots) == 0:
            return

        # Count roles
        attacker_count = sum(1 for r in alive_robots if r.role == "attacker")
        defender_count = sum(1 for r in alive_robots if r.role == "defender")
        support_count = sum(1 for r in alive_robots if r.role == "support")
        scout_count = sum(1 for r in alive_robots if r.role == "scout")

        # Adjust roles based on team needs and robot experience
        if self.robot.experience > 80 and attacker_count < len(alive_robots) * 0.4:
            self.robot.role = "attacker"
        elif self.robot.experience > 70 and defender_count < len(alive_robots) * 0.3:
            self.robot.role = "defender"
        elif self.robot.experience > 60 and support_count < len(alive_robots) * 0.2:
            self.robot.role = "support"
        elif scout_count < len(alive_robots) * 0.1:
            self.robot.role = "scout"
        else:
            # Default role if no specific need
            self.robot.role = "default"

        # Assign role based on team's current objectives
        for obj in self.game_state.objectives:
            if obj.type == ObjectiveType.CAPTURE_THE_FLAG and obj.captured_by != self.robot.team:
                # Need more attackers if flag is not captured
                if attacker_count < 1:
                    self.robot.role = "attacker"
            elif obj.type == ObjectiveType.DEFEND_THE_BASE:
                # Need more defenders if defending
                if defender_count < 1:
                    self.robot.role = "defender"

    def update_memory(self, action: str, success: bool):
        self.memory.append({"action": action, "success": success, "timestamp": time.time()})
        if success:
            self.strategy_history[action] += 1
        else:
            self.strategy_history[action] -= 0.5  # Penalize failures

    def get_best_strategy(self) -> str:
        if not self.strategy_history:
            return "default"
        return max(self.strategy_history, key=self.strategy_history.get)

class Visualizer:
    def __init__(self, game_state: GameState):
        self.game_state = game_state
        self.particle_effects = []
        self.lighting = {"ambient": 0.5, "dynamic": {}}
        self.sound_effects = []

    def add_particle_effect(self, position: Position, color: str, type: str, duration: float):
        self.particle_effects.append({
            "position": position,
            "color": color,
            "type": type,
            "duration": duration,
            "age": 0
        })

    def update_particles(self, delta_time: float):
        for effect in self.particle_effects[:]:
            effect["age"] += delta_time
            if effect["age"] >= effect["duration"]:
                self.particle_effects.remove(effect)

    def update_lighting(self):
        # Dynamic lighting based on explosions, weapons fire, etc.
        self.lighting["ambient"] = max(0.3, min(0.8, self.lighting["ambient"]))
        # Add light sources from explosions and weapons
        for hazard in self.game_state.hazards:
            if hazard.active:
                self.lighting["dynamic"][f"hazard_{id(hazard)}"] = {
                    "position": hazard.position,
                    "intensity": 0.8,
                    "color": "orange"
                }
        for robot in self.game_state.get_alive_robots():
            if robot.weapon == WeaponType.EXPLOSIVE_GRENADE and not robot.cooldowns.get("reload", 0) > 0:
                # Flash from firing
                self.lighting["dynamic"][f"flash_{robot.id}"] = {
                    "position": robot.position,
                    "intensity": 1.0,
                    "color": "yellow",
                    "duration": 0.1
                }

    def play_sound(self, sound_type: str, position: Position, volume: float = 1.0):
        self.sound_effects.append({
            "type": sound_type,
            "position": position,
            "volume": volume,
            "time": time.time()
        })

class CyberArena:
    def __init__(self, team_count: int = 2, robots_per_team: int = 3):
        self.game_state = GameState()
        self.visualizer = Visualizer(self.game_state)
        self.robots_per_team = robots_per_team
        self.team_count = team_count
        self.initialize_game()
        self.ai_brains = {}
        self.last_update_time = time.time()
        self.paused = False
        self.game_log = []

    def initialize_game(self):
        # Create teams
        for i in range(self.team_count):
            team_name = TEAM_COLORS[i]
            team = Team(team_name, TEAM_COLORS[i])
            base_x = random.randint(20, self.game_state.map_size[0] - 20)
            base_y = random.randint(20, self.game_state.map_size[1] - 20)
            team.base_position = Position(base_x, base_y, 0)
            
            # Create robots for each team
            for j in range(self.robots_per_team):
                robot_id = len(self.game_state.robots)
                robot = Robot(
                    id=robot_id,
                    team=team_name,
                    position=Position(base_x + random.uniform(-5, 5), base_y + random.uniform(-5, 5), 0),
                    health=100,
                    max_health=100,
                    weapon=random.choice(list(WEAPON_STATS.keys())),
                    ammo=WEAPON_STATS[random.choice(list(WEAPON_STATS.keys()))]["ammo"]
                )
                team.add_robot(robot)
                self.game_state.robots.append(robot)
                self.ai_brains[robot_id] = AIBrain(robot, self.game_state)

            # Add team to game state
            self.game_state.teams.append(team)

        # Add AI opponent team (optional)
        if self.team_count < MAX_TEAMS:
            ai_team = Team("AI_Opponent", "gray")
            ai_base_x = random.randint(20, self.game_state.map_size[0] - 20)
            ai_base_y = random.randint(20, self.game_state.map_size[1] - 20)
            ai_team.base_position = Position(ai_base_x, ai_base_y, 0)
            
            for j in range(min(2, self.robots_per_team)):
                robot_id = len(self.game_state.robots)
                robot = Robot(
                    id=robot_id,
                    team="AI_Opponent",
                    position=Position(ai_base_x + random.uniform(-5, 5), ai_base_y + random.uniform(-5, 5), 0),
                    health=100,
                    max_health=100,
                    weapon=random.choice(list(WEAPON_STATS.keys())),
                    ammo=WEAPON_STATS[random.choice(list(WEAPON_STATS.keys()))]["ammo"],
                    ai_state=AIState.PATROL
                )
                ai_team.add_robot(robot)
                self.game_state.robots.append(robot)
                self.ai_brains[robot_id] = AIBrain(robot, self.game_state)
            
            self.game_state.teams.append(ai_team)

        # Create objectives
        objective_type = random.choice(list(ObjectiveType))
        if objective_type == ObjectiveType.CAPTURE_THE_FLAG:
            flag_pos = Position(
                random.randint(50, self.game_state.map_size[0] - 50),
                random.randint(50, self.game_state.map_size[1] - 50),
                0
            )
            objective = Objective(
                type=objective_type,
                position=flag_pos,
                team="red",  # Red team's flag
                description="Capture the flag"
            )
            self.game_state.objectives.append(objective)

        elif objective_type == ObjectiveType.DEFEND_THE_BASE:
            # Red team's base is the objective
            red_team = self.game_state.get_team_by_name("red")
            if red_team:
                objective = Objective(
                    type=objective_type,
                    position=red_team.base_position,
                    team="red",
                    description="Defend the red base"
                )
                self.game_state.objectives.append(objective)

        elif objective_type == ObjectiveType.ESCORT_PAYLOAD:
            payload_pos = Position(
                random.randint(30, self.game_state.map_size[0] - 30),
                random.randint(30, self.game_state.map_size[1] - 30),
                0
            )
            objective = Objective(
                type=objective_type,
                position=payload_pos,
                team="blue",
                description="Escort the payload to the goal"
            )
            self.game_state.objectives.append(objective)

        # Create power-ups
        for _ in range(5):
            self.spawn_powerup()

        # Create hazards
        for _ in range(3):
            self.spawn_hazard()

        self.game_state.is_running = True
        self.game_state.last_powerup_spawn = time.time()
        self.game_state.last_hazard_spawn = time.time()
        self.game_log.append("CyberArena initialized with {} teams and {} robots per team".format(self.team_count, self.robots_per_team))

    def spawn_powerup(self):
        if len(self.game_state.powerups) >= 10:
            return
            
        x = random.randint(20, self.game_state.map_size[0] - 20)
        y = random.randint(20, self.game_state.map_size[1] - 20)
        z = 0
        powerup_type = random.choice(list(PowerUpType))
        powerup = PowerUp(
            type=powerup_type,
            position=Position(x, y, z),
            spawn_time=time.time()
        )
        self.game_state.powerups.append(powerup)
        self.visualizer.add_particle_effect(
            powerup.position,
            "cyan" if powerup_type == PowerUpType.HEALTH_PACK else "yellow",
            "sparkle", 0.5
        )

    def spawn_hazard(self):
        x = random.randint(20, self.game_state.map_size[0] - 20)
        y = random.randint(20, self.game_state.map_size[1] - 20)
        z = 0
        hazard = EnvironmentalHazard(
            position=Position(x, y, z),
            radius=Hazard_RADIUS,
            damage_per_second=5,
            spawn_time=time.time()
        )
        self.game_state.hazards.append(hazard)
        self.visualizer.add_particle_effect(
            hazard.position,
            "red",
            "explosion", 1.0
        )

    def update(self, delta_time: float):
        if not self.game_state.is_running or self.paused:
            return

        current_time = time.time()
        self.game_state.current_time += delta_time

        # Update AI brains
        for robot_id, ai in self.ai_brains.items():
            if robot_id < len(self.game_state.robots):
                robot = self.game_state.robots[robot_id]
                if robot.is_alive:
                    ai.update(delta_time)

        # Update robot movement and actions
        for robot in self.game_state.robots:
            if not robot.is_alive:
                continue

            # Update cooldowns
            robot.update_cooldowns(delta_time)

            # Apply speed multiplier
            effective_speed = robot.speed * robot.speed_multiplier

            # Handle AI behavior
            if robot.team != "AI_Opponent":  # Player robots handled by external input
                self.handle_ai_movement(robot, delta_time)

            # Apply damage from hazards if in range
            for hazard in self.game_state.hazards:
                if hazard.active and robot.position.distance_to(hazard.position) < hazard.radius:
                    if current_time - robot.last_heal > 1:  # Only take damage once per second
                        robot.take_damage(hazard.damage_per_second * delta_time)
                        self.visualizer.add_particle_effect(
                            robot.position,
                            "red",
                            "damage", 0.3
                        )

"""
CyberArena - A Multi-Agent Futuristic Battle Arena Simulation

A dynamic, team-based combat simulation featuring AI-controlled robots
with adaptive difficulty, learning capabilities, and immersive audiovisual effects.
"""

import random
import time
import math
import threading
import queue
from enum import Enum
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import List, Dict, Optional, Tuple, Set, Any
from collections import defaultdict, deque
import numpy as np


# ======================
# ENUMERATIONS AND DATA STRUCTURES
# ======================

class Team(Enum):
    RED = "Red"
    BLUE = "Blue"
    NEUTRAL = "Neutral"


class RobotType(Enum):
    ASSAULT = "Assault"
    SUPPORT = "Support"
    RECON = "Recon"
    TANK = "Tank"


class WeaponType(Enum):
    RANGED = "Ranged"
    MELEE = "Melee"
    EXPLOSIVE = "Explosive"
    SUPPORT = "Support"


class ObjectiveType(Enum):
    CAPTURE_FLAG = "CaptureFlag"
    DEFEND_BASE = "DefendBase"
    ESCORT_PAYLOAD = "EscortPayload"
    DOMINATE_CONTROL_POINTS = "DominateControlPoints"


class PowerUpType(Enum):
    SPEED_BOOST = "SpeedBoost"
    SHIELD = "Shield"
    DAMAGE_BOOST = "DamageBoost"
    REGEN = "Regen"
    SILENCE = "Silence"
    TELEPORT = "Teleport"


class HazardType(Enum):
    ELECTRIC_FIELD = "ElectricField"
    FIRE_ZONE = "FireZone"
    GRAVITY_WELL = "GravityWell"
    MINEFIELD = "Minefield"


@dataclass
class Vector2D:
    """2D position and velocity vector"""
    x: float = 0.0
    y: float = 0.0
    
    def __add__(self, other):
        return Vector2D(self.x + other.x, self.y + other.y)
    
    def __sub__(self, other):
        return Vector2D(self.x - other.x, self.y - other.y)
    
    def __mul__(self, scalar):
        return Vector2D(self.x * scalar, self.y * scalar)
    
    def __truediv__(self, scalar):
        return Vector2D(self.x / scalar, self.y / scalar)
    
    def magnitude(self):
        return math.sqrt(self.x**2 + self.y**2)
    
    def normalize(self):
        mag = self.magnitude()
        if mag == 0:
            return Vector2D(0, 0)
        return Vector2D(self.x / mag, self.y / mag)
    
    def distance_to(self, other):
        return (self - other).magnitude()
    
    def to_tuple(self):
        return (self.x, self.y)


@dataclass
class Robot:
    """Represents an AI-controlled robot in the arena"""
    id: int
    team: Team
    robot_type: RobotType
    position: Vector2D
    velocity: Vector2D = field(default_factory=lambda: Vector2D(0, 0))
    health: float = 100.0
    max_health: float = 100.0
    armor: float = 0.0
    energy: float = 100.0
    max_energy: float = 100.0
    weapon: Optional['Weapon'] = None
    objectives: List[ObjectiveType] = field(default_factory=list)
    role: str = "default"
    is_active: bool = True
    last_action_time: float = 0.0
    memory: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)  # For learning and adaptation
    cooldowns: Dict[str, float] = field(default_factory=dict)  # Weapon and ability cooldowns
    
    def __post_init__(self):
        # Initialize memory with empty strategy history
        self.memory = {
            "battle_history": [],
            "success_rate": 0.0,
            "teamwork_score": 0.0,
            "recent_actions": deque(maxlen=20),
            "enemy_patterns": defaultdict(list),
            "preferred_objectives": defaultdict(int)
        }
        
        # Initialize cooldowns
        self.cooldowns = {
            "primary_attack": 0.0,
            "secondary_ability": 0.0,
            "special_ability": 0.0
        }
    
    def take_damage(self, damage: float, attacker_id: int = None) -> float:
        """Apply damage to robot, considering armor"""
        actual_damage = max(0, damage - (damage * self.armor / 100))
        self.health = max(0, self.health - actual_damage)
        
        # Record in memory
        if attacker_id is not None:
            self.memory["recent_actions"].append({
                "type": "damage_taken",
                "amount": actual_damage,
                "attacker": attacker_id,
                "timestamp": time.time()
            })
        
        return actual_damage
    
    def heal(self, amount: float):
        """Heal robot"""
        self.health = min(self.max_health, self.health + amount)
    
    def use_energy(self, amount: float) -> bool:
        """Use energy, return True if successful"""
        if self.energy >= amount:
            self.energy -= amount
            return True
        return False
    
    def recharge_energy(self, amount: float):
        """Recharge energy"""
        self.energy = min(self.max_energy, self.energy + amount)
    
    def add_cooldown(self, ability: str, duration: float):
        """Add cooldown to an ability"""
        self.cooldowns[ability] = time.time() + duration
    
    def is_cooldown_active(self, ability: str) -> bool:
        """Check if ability is on cooldown"""
        return self.cooldowns.get(ability, 0) > time.time()
    
    def can_attack(self) -> bool:
        """Check if robot can perform primary attack"""
        return not self.is_cooldown_active("primary_attack")
    
    def can_use_ability(self) -> bool:
        """Check if robot can use secondary ability"""
        return not self.is_cooldown_active("secondary_ability")
    
    def can_use_special(self) -> bool:
        """Check if robot can use special ability"""
        return not self.is_cooldown_active("special_ability")
    
    def update(self, dt: float):
        """Update robot state"""
        # Update cooldowns
        for ability in self.cooldowns:
            if self.cooldowns[ability] > 0:
                self.cooldowns[ability] -= dt
        
        # Regenerate energy over time
        if self.energy < self.max_energy:
            self.recharge_energy(0.5 * dt)
        
        # Move according to velocity
        self.position = self.position + (self.velocity * dt)
        
        # Slow down velocity over time (friction)
        friction = 0.95
        self.velocity = self.velocity * friction
        
        # Check if dead
        if self.health <= 0:
            self.is_active = False


@dataclass
class Weapon:
    """Represents a weapon used by robots"""
    name: str
    weapon_type: WeaponType
    damage: float
    range: float
    fire_rate: float  # seconds between shots
    energy_cost: float
    projectile_speed: float = 0.0
    area_effect: float = 0.0  # for explosives
    reload_time: float = 0.0
    ammo: int = -1  # -1 means infinite
    max_ammo: int = -1
    
    def __post_init__(self):
        self.last_fired = 0.0
        self.ammo_current = self.ammo if self.ammo > 0 else float('inf')
    
    def can_fire(self, time_now: float) -> bool:
        """Check if weapon can fire"""
        return (time_now - self.last_fired >= self.fire_rate) and self.ammo_current > 0
    
    def fire(self, time_now: float) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Fire weapon and return projectile data"""
        if self.can_fire(time_now):
            self.last_fired = time_now
            self.ammo_current -= 1
            return {
                "damage": self.damage,
                "range": self.range,
                "projectile_speed": self.projectile_speed,
                "area_effect": self.area_effect,
                "weapon_type": self.weapon_type
            }
        return None


@dataclass
class PowerUp:
    """Represents a power-up item in the arena"""
    powerup_type: PowerUpType
    position: Vector2D
    value: float
    duration: float  # how long it lasts
    spawn_time: float = 0.0
    active: bool = True
    
    def __post_init__(self):
        self.spawn_time = time.time()
    
    def is_expired(self) -> bool:
        """Check if power-up has expired"""
        return time.time() - self.spawn_time > self.duration


@dataclass
class Hazard:
    """Represents a hazardous environment element"""
    hazard_type: HazardType
    position: Vector2D
    radius: float
    damage_per_second: float
    duration: float
    spawn_time: float = 0.0
    active: bool = True
    
    def __post_init__(self):
        self.spawn_time = time.time()
    
    def is_expired(self) -> bool:
        """Check if hazard has expired"""
        return time.time() - self.spawn_time > self.duration


@dataclass
class Objective:
    """Represents a team-based objective"""
    objective_type: ObjectiveType
    position: Vector2D
    team_required: Team
    capture_points: int = 0
    max_capture_points: int = 10
    captured_by: Optional[Team] = None
    progress: float = 0.0
    active: bool = True
    description: str = ""
    
    def __post_init__(self):
        if not self.description:
            self.description = f"{self.objective_type.value} at ({self.position.x:.1f}, {self.position.y:.1f})"
    
    def update_progress(self, team: Team, amount: float):
        """Update objective progress"""
        if team != self.team_required:
            # Opposing team reduces progress
            self.progress = max(0, self.progress - amount)
        else:
            # Friendly team increases progress
            self.progress = min(self.max_capture_points, self.progress + amount)
        
        # Check if objective captured
        if self.progress >= self.max_capture_points and self.captured_by != team:
            self.captured_by = team
            self.progress = self.max_capture_points
        elif self.progress <= 0 and self.captured_by == team:
            self.captured_by = None
            self.progress = 0


@dataclass
class GameStats:
    """Tracks game statistics"""
    team_scores: Dict[Team, int] = field(default_factory=lambda: {Team.RED: 0, Team.BLUE: 0})
    kills: Dict[Team, int] = field(default_factory=lambda: {Team.RED: 0, Team.BLUE: 0})
    deaths: Dict[Team, int] = field(default_factory=lambda: {Team.RED: 0, Team.BLUE: 0})
    objectives_completed: Dict[Team, int] = field(default_factory=lambda: {Team.RED: 0, Team.BLUE: 0})
    assists: Dict[Team, int] = field(default_factory=lambda: {Team.RED: 0, Team.BLUE: 0})
    time_elapsed: float = 0.0
    match_active: bool = True
    winner: Optional[Team] = None

class CyberArena:
    """Main CyberArena simulation class"""
    
    def __init__(self, width: int = 1000, height: int = 800, num_robots: int = 12):
        # Arena dimensions
        self.width = width
        self.height = height
        
        # Game state
        self.robot_pool: List[Robot] = []
        self.team_robots: Dict[Team, List[Robot]] = {Team.RED: [], Team.BLUE: []}
        self.powerups: List[PowerUp] = []
        self.hazards: List[Hazard] = []
        self.objectives: List[Objective] = []
        self.projectiles: List[Dict] = []
        self.stats = GameStats()
        
        # Game settings
        self.game_speed = 1.0
        self.last_update = time.time()
        self.game_time = 0.0
        self.difficulty_level = 1.0  # 1.0 = normal, >1.0 = harder
        
        # AI behavior parameters
        self.ai_adaptation_rate = 0.05
        self.learning_enabled = True
        self.team_cooperation_threshold = 0.7  # Minimum team cooperation for reward
        
        # Audiovisual effects
        self.particle_effects: List[Dict] = []
        self.sound_effects_queue = queue.Queue()
        
        # Initialize weapons
        self.weapons = self._initialize_weapons()
        
        # Initialize arena

        # Start simulation thread
        self.running = True
        self.simulation_thread = threading.Thread(target=self._simulation_loop)

    def _initialize_arena(self, num_robots: int):

            self.robot_pool.append(robot)
            self.team_robots[Team.RED].append(robot)
            robot_id += 1
        
        for i in range(blue_count):
            robot_type = robot_types[i % len(robot_types)]
            robot = Robot(
                id=robot_id,
                team=Team.BLUE,
                robot_type=robot_type,

                armor=20 if robot_type == RobotType.TANK else 10,
                max_energy=150 if robot_type == RobotType.SUPPORT else 100

            elif robot_type == RobotType.TANK:
                robot.weapon = self.weapons["rocket_launcher"]

            PowerUpType.TELEPORT
        ]
        
        for i, pos in enumerate(powerup_positions):
            powerup_type = powerup_types[i % len(powerup_types)]

                powerup_type=powerup_type,

        ]

                hazard_type=hazard_type,

            ))
    
    def _simulation_loop(self):
        """Main simulation loop running in a separate thread"""
        while self.running:
            current_time = time.time()
            dt = current_time - self.last_update
            self.last_update = current_time
            
            # Update game time
            self.game_time += dt * self.game_speed
            
            # Update robots
            for robot in self.robot_pool:
                if robot.is_active:
                    self._update_robot_behavior(robot, dt)
                    robot.update(dt)
            
            # Update projectiles
            self._update_projectiles(dt)
            
            # Update power-ups
            self._update_powerups()
            
            # Update hazards
            self._update_hazards()
            
            # Update objectives
            self._update_objectives(dt)
            
            # Update game stats
            self._update_stats()
            
            # Check win conditions
            self._check_win_conditions()
            
            # Adjust difficulty based on performance
            self._adjust_difficulty()
            
            # Add some artificial delay to control simulation speed
            time.sleep(max(0, 0.016 - dt))  # ~60 FPS
            
        print("Simulation stopped")
    
    def _update_robot_behavior(self, robot: Robot, dt: float):
        """Update AI behavior for a single robot"""
        if not robot.is_active:
            return
        
        # Get team and enemies
        teammates = [r for r in self.team_robots[robot.team] if r.is_active and r.id != robot.id]
        enemies = [r for r in self.robot_pool if r.team != robot.team and r.is_active]
        
        # Get objectives
        objectives = [obj for obj in self.objectives if obj.active and obj.captured_by != robot.team]
        
        # Determine role based on robot type and current situation
        self._assign_role(robot, teammates, enemies, objectives)
        
        # If no targets, move to objectives
        if not enemies:
            self._move_to_nearest_objective(robot, objectives)
        else:
            # Use AI to make decisions based on strategy
            self._make_combat_decision(robot, teammates, enemies, objectives)
        
        # Update memory with recent actions
        self._update_robot_memory(robot, teammates, enemies, objectives)
    
    def _assign_role(self, robot: Robot, teammates: List[Robot], enemies: List[Robot], objectives: List[Objective]):
        """Assign dynamic role based on team composition and situation"""
        # Base role assignment by robot type
        base_role_map = {
            RobotType.ASSAULT: "attacker",
            RobotType.SUPPORT: "healer",
            RobotType.RECON: "scout",
            RobotType.TANK: "tank"
        }
        
        # Get current role
        role = base_role_map[robot.robot_type]
        
        # Dynamic role adjustment based on team needs
        if len(teammates) > 0:
            # Check if we need a healer
            if robot.robot_type == RobotType.SUPPORT and any(t.health < t.max_health * 0.5 for t in teammates):
                role = "healer"
            # Check if we need a tank
            elif robot.robot_type == RobotType.TANK and any(e.weapon.weapon_type == WeaponType.EXPLOSIVE for e in enemies):
                role = "tank"
            # Check if we need a scout
            elif robot.robot_type == RobotType.RECON and len(enemies) > 0: 
                role = "scout"
            # Check if we need a flanker
            elif robot.robot_type == RobotType.ASSAULT and len([e for e in enemies if e.position.distance_to(robot.position) < 150]) > 0:
                role = "flanker"
        
        robot.role = role
    
    def _make_combat_decision(self, robot: Robot, teammates: List[Robot], enemies: List[Robot], objectives: List[Objective]):
        """Make combat decision based on AI strategy"""
        # Find nearest enemy in range
        nearest_enemy = None
        min_distance = float('inf')
        
        for enemy in enemies:
            distance = robot.position.distance_to(enemy.position)
            if distance < min_distance and distance < robot.weapon.range + 100:
                min_distance = distance
                nearest_enemy = enemy
        
        # If we have a target and can attack, attack
        if nearest_enemy and robot.can_attack() and robot.weapon:
            # Check if we're in melee range for melee weapons
            if robot.weapon.weapon_type == WeaponType.MELEE and min_distance <= robot.weapon.range:
                # Use melee attack
                self._use_weapon(robot, nearest_enemy)
                self._add_particle_effect(robot.position, "impact", robot.team)
                self._play_sound("melee_hit")
                
                # Update memory
                robot.memory["recent_actions"].append({
                    "type": "attack",
                    "target": nearest_enemy.id,
                    "weapon": robot.weapon.name,
                    "timestamp": time.time()
                })
                
            elif robot.weapon.weapon_type != WeaponType.MELEE and min_distance <= robot.weapon.range:
                # Use ranged attack
                self._shoot_at_target(robot, nearest_enemy)
                self._add_particle_effect(robot.position, "fire", robot.team)
                self._play_sound("fire")                
                # Update memory
                robot.memory["recent_actions"].append({
                    "type": "ranged_attack",
                    "target": nearest_enemy.id,
                    "weapon": robot.weapon.name,
                    "timestamp": time.time()
                })
                
                # If there are multiple enemies, try to hit the most dangerous one
                if len(enemies) > 1:
                    # Calculate threat level
                    threats = sorted(enemies, key=lambda e: e.health / e.max_health if e.max_health > 0 else 1)
                    if threats:
                        target = threats[0]
                        if target.position.distance_to(robot.position) < 300:
                            self._shoot_at_target(robot, target)
            
            # For support robots, heal teammates if needed
            elif robot.weapon.weapon_type == WeaponType.SUPPORT and len(teammates) > 0:
                # Find lowest health teammate
                lowest_health = float('inf')
                target_teammate = None
                
                for teammate in teammates:
                    if teammate.health < lowest_health and teammate.health < teammate.max_health * 0.7:
                        lowest_health = teammate.health
                        target_teammate = teammate
                
                if target_teammate and robot.position.distance_to(target_teammate.position) <= robot.weapon.range:
                    self._use_support_ability(robot, target_teammate)
                    self._add_particle_effect(robot.position, "heal", robot.team)
                    self._play_sound("heal")
                    
                    # Update memory
                    robot.memory["recent_actions"].append({
                        "type": "heal",
                        "target": target_teammate.id,
                        "weapon": robot.weapon.name,
                        "timestamp": time.time()
                    })
        
        # If no targets or can't attack, move strategically
        elif len(enemies) > 0:
            # Find safest position
            if robot.role == "tank":
                # Move to intercept enemies and protect teammates
                target_pos = self._find_intercept_position(robot, enemies, teammates)
                self._move_towards(robot, target_pos)
                
            elif robot.role == "healer":
                # Move to support teammates
                target_teammate = None
                min_dist = float('inf')
                
                for teammate in teammates:
                    if teammate.health < teammate.max_health * 0.6:
                        dist = robot.position.distance_to(teammate.position)
                        if dist < min_dist:
                            min_dist = dist
                            target_teammate = teammate
                
                if target_teammate:
                    self._move_towards(robot, target_teammate.position)
                else:
                    # Move towards nearest objective
                    self._move_to_nearest_objective(robot, objectives)
                    
            elif robot.role == "scout":
                # Move to flank enemy from side
                flank_position = self._find_flank_position(robot, enemies)
                if flank_position:
                    self._move_towards(robot, flank_position)
                else:
                    self._move_towards(robot, enemies[0].position)
                    
            elif robot.role == "flanker":
                # Move to flank position
                flank_position = self._find_flank_position(robot, enemies)
                if flank_position:
                    self._move_towards(robot, flank_position)
                else:
                    self._move_towards(robot, enemies[0].position)
                    
            else:  # attacker
                # Move towards nearest enemy
                nearest_enemy = min(enemies, key=lambda e: robot.position.distance_to(e.position))
                self._move_towards(robot, nearest_enemy.position)
        
        # If no enemies, move to objectives
        else:
            self._move_to_nearest_objective(robot, objectives)
    
    def _find_intercept_position(self, robot: Robot, enemies: List[Robot], teammates: List[Robot]) -> Vector2D:
        """Find a position to intercept enemies and protect teammates"""
        if not enemies:
            return robot.position
        
        # Calculate average enemy position
        avg_enemy_pos = Vector2D(0, 0)
        for e in enemies:
            avg_enemy_pos = avg_enemy_pos + e.position
        avg_enemy_pos = avg_enemy_pos / len(enemies)
        
        # Find average teammate position
        avg_team_pos = Vector2D(0, 0)
        for t in teammates:
            avg_team_pos = avg_team_pos + t.position
        avg_team_pos = avg_team_pos / len(teammates)
        
        # Position between teammates and enemies, slightly towards enemies
        direction = avg_enemy_pos - avg_team_pos
        intercept_pos = avg_team_pos + direction.normalize() * (direction.magnitude() * 0.3)
        
        # Keep within arena bounds
        intercept_pos.x = max(10, min(intercept_pos.x, self.width - 10))
        intercept_pos.y = max(10, min(intercept_pos.y, self.height - 10))
        
        return intercept_pos
    
    def _find_flank_position(self, robot: Robot, enemies: List[Robot]) -> Optional[Vector2D]:
        """Find a flank position to attack from the side"""
        if not enemies:
            return None
        
        # Find the enemy closest to robot
        nearest_enemy = min(enemies, key=lambda e: robot.position.distance_to(e.position))
        
        # Calculate perpendicular direction to enemy's movement
        if nearest_enemy.velocity.magnitude() > 0:
            # Rotate velocity vector 90 degrees
            perp_vec = Vector2D(-nearest_enemy.velocity.y, nearest_enemy.velocity.x)
            perp_vec = perp_vec.normalize()
        else:
            # Use direction from robot to enemy
            direction = nearest_enemy.position - robot.position
            if direction.magnitude() == 0:
                return None
            perp_vec = Vector2D(-direction.y, direction.x).normalize()
        
        # Find flank position
        flank_offset = perp_vec * random.uniform(80, 150)
        flank_pos = nearest_enemy.position + flank_offset
        
        # Keep within arena bounds
        flank_pos.x = max(10, min(flank_pos.x, self.width - 10))
        flank_pos.y = max(10, min(flank_pos.y, self.height - 10))
        
        return flank_pos
    
    def _move_towards(self, robot: Robot, target: Vector2D):
        """Make robot move towards target"""
        if robot.position.distance_to(target) < 10:
            return
        
        direction = (target - robot.position).normalize()
        speed = 100 if robot.role == "scout" else 70  # Scouts move faster
        
        # Apply power-up speed boost if active
        for powerup in self.powerups:
            if powerup.active and powerup.powerup_type == PowerUpType.SPEED_BOOST:
                if robot.position.distance_to(powerup.position) < 40:
                    speed *= powerup.value
        
        robot.velocity = direction * speed
    
    def _move_to_nearest_objective(self, robot: Robot, objectives: List[Objective]):
        """Move robot towards the nearest objective"""
        if not objectives:
            return
        
        # Find nearest objective
        nearest_obj = min(objectives, key=lambda o: robot.position.distance_to(o.position))
        self._move_towards(robot, nearest_obj.position)

@dataclass
class Vector2D:
    """2D position and velocity vector"""
    x: float = 0.0
    y: float = 0.0
    
    def __add__(self, other):
        return Vector2D(self.x + other.x, self.y + other.y)
    
    def __sub__(self, other):
        return Vector2D(self.x - other.x, self.y - other.y)
    
    def __mul__(self, scalar):
        return Vector2D(self.x * scalar, self.y * scalar)
    
    def __truediv__(self, scalar):
        return Vector2D(self.x / scalar, self.y / scalar)
    
    def magnitude(self):
        return math.sqrt(self.x**2 + self.y**2)
    
    def normalize(self):
        mag = self.magnitude()
        if mag == 0:
            return Vector2D(0, 0)
        return Vector2D(self.x / mag, self.y / mag)
    
    def distance_to(self, other):
        return (self - other).magnitude()
    
    def to_tuple(self):
        return (self.x, self.y)


@dataclass
class Robot:
    """Represents an AI-controlled robot in the arena"""
    id: int
    team: Team
    robot_type: RobotType
    position: Vector2D
    velocity: Vector2D = field(default_factory=lambda: Vector2D(0, 0))
    health: float = 100.0
    max_health: float = 100.0
    armor: float = 0.0
    energy: float = 100.0
    max_energy: float = 100.0
    weapon: Optional['Weapon'] = None
    objectives: List[ObjectiveType] = field(default_factory=list)
    role: str = "default"
    is_active: bool = True
    last_action_time: float = 0.0
    memory: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)  # For learning and adaptation
    cooldowns: Dict[str, float] = field(default_factory=dict)  # Weapon and ability cooldowns
    
    def __post_init__(self):
        # Initialize memory with empty strategy history
        self.memory = {
            "battle_history": [],
            "success_rate": 0.0,
            "teamwork_score": 0.0,
            "recent_actions": deque(maxlen=20),
            "enemy_patterns": defaultdict(list),
            "preferred_objectives": defaultdict(int)
        }
        
        # Initialize cooldowns
        self.cooldowns = {
            "primary_attack": 0.0,
            "secondary_ability": 0.0,
            "special_ability": 0.0
        }
    
    def take_damage(self, damage: float, attacker_id: int = None) -> float:
        """Apply damage to robot, considering armor"""
        actual_damage = max(0, damage - (damage * self.armor / 100))
        self.health = max(0, self.health - actual_damage)
        
        # Record in memory
        if attacker_id is not None:
            self.memory["recent_actions"].append({
                "type": "damage_taken",
                "amount": actual_damage,
                "attacker": attacker_id,
                "timestamp": time.time()
            })
        
        return actual_damage
    
    def heal(self, amount: float):
        """Heal robot"""
        self.health = min(self.max_health, self.health + amount)
    
    def use_energy(self, amount: float) -> bool:
        """Use energy, return True if successful"""
        if self.energy >= amount:
            self.energy -= amount
            return True
        return False
    
    def recharge_energy(self, amount: float):
        """Recharge energy"""
        self.energy = min(self.max_energy, self.energy + amount)
    
    def add_cooldown(self, ability: str, duration: float):
        """Add cooldown to an ability"""
        self.cooldowns[ability] = time.time() + duration
    
    def is_cooldown_active(self, ability: str) -> bool:
        """Check if ability is on cooldown"""
        return self.cooldowns.get(ability, 0) > time.time()
    
    def can_attack(self) -> bool:
        """Check if robot can perform primary attack"""
        return not self.is_cooldown_active("primary_attack")
    
    def can_use_ability(self) -> bool:
        """Check if robot can use secondary ability"""
        return not self.is_cooldown_active("secondary_ability")
    
    def can_use_special(self) -> bool:
        """Check if robot can use special ability"""
        return not self.is_cooldown_active("special_ability")
    
    def update(self, dt: float):
        """Update robot state"""
        # Update cooldowns
        for ability in self.cooldowns:
            if self.cooldowns[ability] > 0:
                self.cooldowns[ability] -= dt
        
        # Regenerate energy over time
        if self.energy < self.max_energy:
            self.recharge_energy(0.5 * dt)
        
        # Move according to velocity
        self.position = self.position + (self.velocity * dt)
        
        # Slow down velocity over time (friction)
        friction = 0.95
        self.velocity = self.velocity * friction
        
        # Check if dead
        if self.health <= 0:
            self.is_active = False


@dataclass
class Weapon:
    """Represents a weapon used by robots"""
    name: str
    weapon_type: WeaponType
    damage: float
    range: float
    fire_rate: float  # seconds between shots
    energy_cost: float
    projectile_speed: float = 0.0
    area_effect: float = 0.0  # for explosives
    reload_time: float = 0.0
    ammo: int = -1  # -1 means infinite
    max_ammo: int = -1
    
    def __post_init__(self):
        self.last_fired = 0.0
        self.ammo_current = self.ammo if self.ammo > 0 else float('inf')
    
    def can_fire(self, time_now: float) -> bool:
        """Check if weapon can fire"""
        return (time_now - self.last_fired >= self.fire_rate) and self.ammo_current > 0
    
    def fire(self, time_now: float) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Fire weapon and return projectile data"""
        if self.can_fire(time_now):
            self.last_fired = time_now
            self.ammo_current -= 1
            return {
                "damage": self.damage,
                "range": self.range,
                "projectile_speed": self.projectile_speed,
                "area_effect": self.area_effect,
                "weapon_type": self.weapon_type
            }
        return None

class Objective:

    objective_type: ObjectiveType
    position: Vector2D

    capture_points: int = 0
    max_capture_points: int = 10
    captured_by: Optional[Team] = None
    progress: float = 0.0

    description: str = ""

        if not self.description:
            self.description = f"{self.objective_type.value} at ({self.position.x:.1f}, {self.position.y:.1f})"
    
    def update_progress(self, team: Team, amount: float):
        """Update objective progress"""
        if team != self.team_required:
            # Opposing team reduces progress
            self.progress = max(0, self.progress - amount)
        else:
            # Friendly team increases progress
            self.progress = min(self.max_capture_points, self.progress + amount)
        
        # Check if objective captured
        if self.progress >= self.max_capture_points and self.captured_by != team:
            self.captured_by = team
            self.progress = self.max_capture_points
        elif self.progress <= 0 and self.captured_by == team:
            self.captured_by = None
            self.progress = 0

    def _assign_role(self, robot: Robot, teammates: List[Robot], enemies: List[Robot], objectives: List[Objective]):
        """Assign dynamic role based on team composition and situation"""

    def _find_intercept_position(self, robot: Robot, enemies: List[Robot], teammates: List[Robot]) -> Vector2D:

        # Calculate average enemy position

        avg_enemy_pos = avg_enemy_pos / len(enemies)

        avg_team_pos = avg_team_pos / len(teammates)

"""
CyberArena - A Multi-Agent Futuristic Battle Arena Simulation

import random
import time
import math
import threading
import queue
from enum import Enum
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

@dataclass
class Vector2D:
    """2D position and velocity vector"""
    x: float = 0.0
    y: float = 0.0
    
    def __add__(self, other):
        return Vector2D(self.x + other.x, self.y + other.y)
    
    def __sub__(self, other):
        return Vector2D(self.x - other.x, self.y - other.y)
    
    def __mul__(self, scalar):
        return Vector2D(self.x * scalar, self.y * scalar)
    
    def __truediv__(self, scalar):
        return Vector2D(self.x / scalar, self.y / scalar)
    
    def magnitude(self):
        return math.sqrt(self.x**2 + self.y**2)
    
    def normalize(self):
        mag = self.magnitude()
        if mag == 0:
            return Vector2D(0, 0)
        return Vector2D(self.x / mag, self.y / mag)
    
    def distance_to(self, other):
        return (self - other).magnitude()
    
    def to_tuple(self):
        return (self.x, self.y)


@dataclass
class Robot:
    """Represents an AI-controlled robot in the arena"""
    id: int
    team: Team
    robot_type: RobotType
    position: Vector2D
    velocity: Vector2D = field(default_factory=lambda: Vector2D(0, 0))
    health: float = 100.0
    max_health: float = 100.0
    armor: float = 0.0
    energy: float = 100.0
    max_energy: float = 100.0
    weapon: Optional['Weapon'] = None
    objectives: List[ObjectiveType] = field(default_factory=list)
    role: str = "default"
    is_active: bool = True
    last_action_time: float = 0.0
    memory: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)  # For learning and adaptation
    cooldowns: Dict[str, float] = field(default_factory=dict)  # Weapon and ability cooldowns
    
    def __post_init__(self):
        # Initialize memory with empty strategy history
        self.memory = {
            "battle_history": [],
            "success_rate": 0.0,
            "teamwork_score": 0.0,
            "recent_actions": deque(maxlen=20),
            "enemy_patterns": defaultdict(list),
            "preferred_objectives": defaultdict(int)
        }
        
        # Initialize cooldowns
        self.cooldowns = {
            "primary_attack": 0.0,
            "secondary_ability": 0.0,
            "special_ability": 0.0
        }
    
    def take_damage(self, damage: float, attacker_id: int = None) -> float:
        """Apply damage to robot, considering armor"""
        actual_damage = max(0, damage - (damage * self.armor / 100))
        self.health = max(0, self.health - actual_damage)
        
        # Record in memory
        if attacker_id is not None:
            self.memory["recent_actions"].append({
                "type": "damage_taken",
                "amount": actual_damage,
                "attacker": attacker_id,
                "timestamp": time.time()
            })
        
        return actual_damage
    
    def heal(self, amount: float):
        """Heal robot"""
        self.health = min(self.max_health, self.health + amount)
    
    def use_energy(self, amount: float) -> bool:
        """Use energy, return True if successful"""
        if self.energy >= amount:
            self.energy -= amount
            return True
        return False
    
    def recharge_energy(self, amount: float):
        """Recharge energy"""
        self.energy = min(self.max_energy, self.energy + amount)
    
    def add_cooldown(self, ability: str, duration: float):
        """Add cooldown to an ability"""
        self.cooldowns[ability] = time.time() + duration
    
    def is_cooldown_active(self, ability: str) -> bool:
        """Check if ability is on cooldown"""
        return self.cooldowns.get(ability, 0) > time.time()
    
    def can_attack(self) -> bool:
        """Check if robot can perform primary attack"""
        return not self.is_cooldown_active("primary_attack")
    
    def can_use_ability(self) -> bool:
        """Check if robot can use secondary ability"""
        return not self.is_cooldown_active("secondary_ability")
    
    def can_use_special(self) -> bool:
        """Check if robot can use special ability"""
        return not self.is_cooldown_active("special_ability")
    
    def update(self, dt: float):
        """Update robot state"""
        # Update cooldowns
        for ability in self.cooldowns:
            if self.cooldowns[ability] > 0:
                self.cooldowns[ability] -= dt
        
        # Regenerate energy over time
        if self.energy < self.max_energy:
            self.recharge_energy(0.5 * dt)
        
        # Move according to velocity
        self.position = self.position + (self.velocity * dt)
        
        # Slow down velocity over time (friction)
        friction = 0.95
        self.velocity = self.velocity * friction
        
        # Check if dead
        if self.health <= 0:
            self.is_active = False


@dataclass
class Weapon:
    """Represents a weapon used by robots"""
    name: str
    weapon_type: WeaponType
    damage: float
    range: float
    fire_rate: float  # seconds between shots
    energy_cost: float
    projectile_speed: float = 0.0
    area_effect: float = 0.0  # for explosives
    reload_time: float = 0.0
    ammo: int = -1  # -1 means infinite
    max_ammo: int = -1
    
    def __post_init__(self):
        self.last_fired = 0.0
        self.ammo_current = self.ammo if self.ammo > 0 else float('inf')
    
    def can_fire(self, time_now: float) -> bool:
        """Check if weapon can fire"""
        return (time_now - self.last_fired >= self.fire_rate) and self.ammo_current > 0
    
    def fire(self, time_now: float) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Fire weapon and return projectile data"""
        if self.can_fire(time_now):
            self.last_fired = time_now
            self.ammo_current -= 1
            return {
                "damage": self.damage,
                "range": self.range,
                "projectile_speed": self.projectile_speed,
                "area_effect": self.area_effect,
                "weapon_type": self.weapon_type
            }
        return None

@dataclass
class Objective:
    """Represents a team-based objective"""
    objective_type: ObjectiveType
    position: Vector2D
    team_required: Team
    capture_points: int = 0
    max_capture_points: int = 10
    captured_by: Optional[Team] = None
    progress: float = 0.0
    active: bool = True
    description: str = ""
    
    def __post_init__(self):
        if not self.description:
            self.description = f"{self.objective_type.value} at ({self.position.x:.1f}, {self.position.y:.1f})"
    
    def update_progress(self, team: Team, amount: float):
        """Update objective progress"""
        if team != self.team_required:
            # Opposing team reduces progress
            self.progress = max(0, self.progress - amount)
        else:
            # Friendly team increases progress
            self.progress = min(self.max_capture_points, self.progress + amount)
        
        # Check if objective captured
        if self.progress >= self.max_capture_points and self.captured_by != team:
            self.captured_by = team
            self.progress = self.max_capture_points
        elif self.progress <= 0 and self.captured_by == team:
            self.captured_by = None
            self.progress = 0
